rationale:
Junior council development engineering role reviewing development applications and engineering designs; overlaps Marc's road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design training in Civil 3D and AutoCAD and his completed BSCE.
The applicant profile asks for a civil engineering degree currently in 3rd/4th year OR solid contemporary development engineering experience, plus required exposure to NSW EP&A Act, Roads Act and Local Government Act.
Temporary full-time, Wyong NSW (hybrid 3 days onsite), closes midnight Sunday 18 Oct 2026; would need relocation to the Central Coast.
caution: Advert is aimed at current students or experienced development engineers; Marc completed his BSCE in 2019 and has no NSW development engineering experience. Phone John Noakes before applying to ask whether a completed degree plus Advanced Diploma qualifies.
gaps: NSW planning legislation exposure (EP&A Act, Roads Act, Local Government Act)
mandatory_unresolved: Applicant profile: currently completing a Civil Engineering degree (3rd/4th yr) OR solid contemporary development engineering experience; Marc has a completed BSCE (2019) and Advanced Diploma (Feb 2026) but is neither a current student nor an experienced development engineer
Exposure to the NSW Environmental Planning and Assessment Act, Roads Act and Local Government Act is required
Class C or P1/P2 driver licence: Marc holds a Victorian licence (would need to transfer to NSW if he relocates)
apply_instructions: SEEK link-out to Central Coast Council careers portal (TechnologyOne CiAnywhere). Contact: John Noakes, Section Manager Development Engineering, 0417 486 569. No agencies.
title: Junior Development Engineer
